glosses: Not containing animal products (meat, eggs, milk, leather, etc) or inherently involving animal use.

examples.text: He eats a completely vegan diet.
Is their way of eating healthy and safe? Doctors and nutritionists generally give an almost unqualified “yes” to lacto‐ovo vegetarianism, but express some doubts about vegan diets.
The interest of heavyweight investors is confirmation that vegan food has gone mainstream, but it could also make it harder for Oatly to maintain its anti-establishment image.

glosses: Committed to avoiding any product or practice that inherently involves animal use.

examples.text: She is not vegan as she eats eggs and wears leather.
Yesterday I went to a vegan party.
She is interested in vegan philosophy.

glosses: A person who does not eat, drink or otherwise consume any animal products

A person committed to avoiding products and practices that inherently involve animal use, including all foods containing animal products, and to abstaining from direct and intentional harm to animals as far as possible; an adherent to veganism.

examples.text: Our vegan-friendly shaving brush is made with synthetic bristles instead of badger hair.

glosses: A vegan activist, one who campaigns for change regarding animal rights and vegan issues.
Qui est adepte du végétalisme, principe diététique et éthique recommandant l’usage alimentaire unique des végétaux et l’exclusion de la viande, du poisson et de tout produit d’origine animale.

examples.text: Alors que les végétariens ne consomment ni viande ni poisson, que les végétaliens ne consomment ni viande, ni poisson, ni œufs, ni laitages, les vegans ajoutent à ces exclusions alimentaires le refus d’utiliser tout produit issu du règne animal : miel, laine, cuir…
